Print method for pd_adjust objects

Source: R/pd.adjust.R
print.pd_adjust.Rd

Prints a header with the number of tests \(m\), \(\pi_0\), the unadjusted threshold \(c\) and the adjusted threshold \(c^*\) (a direction is claimed when \(pd \ge c^*\)), followed by the per-test table and a short note on pd.adj. Columns that take the same value in every row (null.value, direction) are reported once in the header. The full set of columns remains available for programmatic access via the usual $ and [.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'pd_adjust'
print(x, digits = 4, ...)

Arguments

x

A pd_adjust object returned by pd.adjust.

digits

Number of digits used when printing. Defaults to 4.

...

Further arguments passed to print.data.frame.

Value

x, invisibly.
